review_evidence: README states that the repository provides executable Lean specifications of cryptographic algorithms, including Classic McEliece, plus experiments for automated reasoning.

Direct inspection of lib/Crypto/Mceliece/Ref348864.lean found the parameterized algorithm specification, finite-field representations and operations, public-key representation, and associated proof obligations; lib/Crypto also contains reusable AES, bit-vector, matrix, random, and byte-vector source.

Direct inspection of lakefile.lean found Lake-specific C/FFI compilation targets, source-file lists, external static-library rules, dependency and executable/library targets, and test runner/update scripts.

rules.content_invariant: The selected lakefile is build/test orchestration only. Cryptographic specifications, mathematical data structures, proof obligations, algorithm implementations, and reusable interfaces remain retained under lib/**, with tests retained separately.
evidence: lakefile.lean defines Lake FilePath/build jobs and external-library targets for C bindings, Keccak and OpenSSL, plus Lake targets and scripts; the McEliece/AES/SHAKE specifications themselves are in retained lib/Crypto/** files.
rules.rationale: Exclude the exact Lake build/FFI/test orchestration file from primary formalization search without removing any cryptographic specification source.

summary: Retain the executable cryptographic specifications and supporting Lean library; exclude only the exact Lake/FFI/test build script.
